note: Didactic scenarios written for AeroLex. The callsign LEXAIR, the SID ROSAL 1A and every frequency are fictitious. Not for operational use.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, cleared to Madrid via ROSAL one alpha departure, climb flight level eight zero, squawk four five two one.
steps.readback: Cleared to Madrid via ROSAL one alpha departure, flight level eight zero, squawk four five two one, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Cleared to Madrid via ROSAL one alpha departure, flight level eight zero, squawk four two five one, Lexair one two three.

note.es: La autorización de ruta, el nivel y el código transpondedor se colacionan siempre.
note.en: The route clearance, the level and the transponder code are always read back.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, taxi to holding point runway one seven via taxiway alpha, QNH one zero one three.
steps.readback: Taxi to holding point runway one seven via alpha, QNH one zero one three, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Taxi to holding point runway one seven via alpha, QNH one zero three one, Lexair one two three.

note.es: El reglaje altimétrico (QNH) y la pista en uso se colacionan siempre.
note.en: The altimeter setting (QNH) and the runway in use are always read back.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, line up and wait runway one seven.
steps.readback: Line up and wait runway one seven, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Line up and wait runway three five, Lexair one two three.

note.es: Cualquier instrucción para entrar en una pista se colaciona con el número de pista.
note.en: Any instruction to enter a runway is read back with the runway designator.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, wind one eight zero degrees eight knots, runway one seven, cleared for take-off.
steps.readback: Runway one seven, cleared for take-off, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Cleared for take-off, Lexair one two three.

note.es: La autorización de despegue se colaciona con la pista; el viento es información y no hace falta repetirlo.
note.en: The take-off clearance is read back with the runway; the wind is information and does not need to be repeated.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, contact Departure one two zero decimal four five.
steps.readback: Departure one two zero decimal four five, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Departure one two one decimal four five, Lexair one two three.

note.es: Las frecuencias nuevas se colacionan para confirmar que se va a sintonizar la correcta.
note.en: New frequencies are read back to confirm the right one will be tuned.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, identified, climb flight level one two zero.
steps.readback: Climb flight level one two zero, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Climb flight level one zero zero, Lexair one two three.

note.es: «Identified» es información; la instrucción de nivel es lo que se colaciona.
note.en: "Identified" is information; the level instruction is what gets read back.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, turn left heading one three five.
steps.readback: Left heading one three five, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Right heading one three five, Lexair one two three.

note.es: En un cambio de rumbo se colacionan el sentido del giro y el rumbo.
note.en: For a heading change, both the direction of turn and the heading are read back.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, descend flight level seven zero, reduce speed two five zero knots.
steps.readback: Descend flight level seven zero, speed two five zero knots, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Descend flight level seven zero, speed two zero five knots, Lexair one two three.

note.es: Las instrucciones de nivel y de velocidad se colacionan siempre.
note.en: Level and speed instructions are always read back.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, descend altitude five thousand feet, QNH one zero one eight.
steps.readback: Descend altitude five thousand feet, QNH one zero one eight, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Descend altitude five thousand feet, QNH one zero zero eight, Lexair one two three.

note.es: Al autorizar por primera vez a una altitud por debajo del nivel de transición se da el QNH, que se colaciona.
note.en: When first cleared to an altitude below the transition level, the QNH is given and read back.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, cleared ILS approach runway three two right.
steps.readback: Cleared ILS approach runway three two right, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Cleared ILS approach runway three two left, Lexair one two three.

note.es: En la autorización de aproximación se colacionan el tipo de aproximación y la pista, incluida la letra L, C o R.
note.en: In an approach clearance, the type of approach and the runway, including the L, C or R letter, are read back.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, contact Tower one one eight decimal one five.
steps.readback: Tower one one eight decimal one five, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Tower one one eight decimal five one, Lexair one two three.

note.es: Las frecuencias nuevas se colacionan siempre.
note.en: New frequencies are always read back.

steps.atc: Lexair one two three, wind three three zero degrees six knots, runway three two right, cleared to land.
steps.readback: Runway three two right, cleared to land, Lexair one two three.

wrong.text: Cleared to land, Lexair one two three.

note.es: La autorización de aterrizaje se colaciona con la pista.
note.en: The landing clearance is read back with the runway.
